subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, with channel-selective replies handled as a separate delivery-policy/API decision?
rationale: The current source gap is narrow and concrete, but letting prompts choose or suppress outbound channels changes channel delivery behavior and plugin/channel contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in the command prompt bundle.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Keep a separate follow-up for prompt-driven or rule-driven channel-selective replies before changing delivery semantics.

options.title: Reject Prompt-Driven Routing
options.body: Document that outbound routing remains host-controlled and close only the broader selective-routing portion after the metadata fix lands.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in the command prompt bundle.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared command prompt bundle and prior scope guidance both point to this person as the clearest owner for deciding the metadata-versus-routing boundary.
